title: [CONTINUATION] Corrected M11/M12 evaluation and verified learning-to-mathematics gates
body:
Parent: #1. This issue tracks the unresolved scientific acceptance gates after the verified runtime and ORION-V2 integration publication. Engineering fixes and receipt checks do not renew historical protected conclusions.

- [ ] **M11:** Freeze fresh scenarios and exact incumbent/target/predecessor identities before outcome access. Use a stronger learned diagnosis parent with the same candidate channel, information and resource budgets. Evaluate protected assurance, externally authorized adoption, preservation and rollback. The seven historical adoption cells remain reopened until warranted by new evidence.
- [ ] **M12:** Prospectively construct exactly matched transfer pairs to replace the six-versus-four mismatch without inventing observations. Define persistent-language grading that preserves valid prior knowledge and alternative support. Freeze varied lifetime/order/failure families, the inferential unit and analysis, then record new outcomes and receipt identities.
- [ ] **Broader skills:** Declare an expanded method/representation language and preservation rules. Evaluate unseen construction families, retention, revocation, harmful transfer and total acquisition/verification/storage cost against the strongest faithful parent.
- [ ] **Proof route:** Pin a proof-kernel adapter and library versions; bind theorem statements, assumptions, dependency closure and whole-proof replay. Demonstrate known proof reconstruction, unseen composition and learned reusable proofs with revocation before a prospectively identified open target.
- [ ] **Independent claims review:** Keep evaluator authority outside candidate control; obtain statement-correspondence and novelty review before claiming an unsolved mathematical result or epistemic improvement.
- [ ] **Disposition:** Publish explicit supported, parent-sufficient, harmful or CANNOT_CHECK terminals. A closed study does not necessarily mean a positive scientific result.

Current engineering reference: merged main `173a2443dda712c4131659a9d8037044f70f1022` via #39 and #40. Source-bound theory integration, historical runtime continuation, missing legacy checker/test custody and read-only evaluation prerequisites are integrated. `research/evaluation-continuation-v1/` provides matching, lifecycle-grading and self-change-binding checks; it does not supply the protected outcomes or external authority required by the checklist above. The four-row theory integration remains scoped engineering evidence.

Keep grand programme #1 open. This issue does not authorize access to protected evaluator data or change existing scientific acceptance criteria.
